verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for any software product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Digits publishing its source under an open license. The published OpenAPI spec, llms.txt and markdown docs mirrors are documentation and interface descriptions, not product source code, so they earn no credit. The vendor also describes its core models as "Proprietary AI models."

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
